result.stdout:
runx - repo command runner for .NET projects

Usage:
  runx [options]                         Pick a task to run (lists tasks when not interactive).
  runx [options] <task> [-- <args>...]   Run a task.

Options:
  --help                  Show help.
  --version               Show version.
  --list                  List tasks without prompting.
  --init                  Create a starter runx.json.
  --init --personal       Create your personal tasks file for this repo, outside the repo.
  --scope <scope>         With --init --personal: global, a remote such as origin, or repo.
  --force                 Overwrite an existing file with --init.
  --where                 Show which task files apply here.
  --new <name>            Create a script task in the task folder (eng/tasks by default).
    --type <type>         ps1 (the default), cs, sh, or cmd.
    --description <text>  The task's description.
    --depends <task>      A task to run first. Repeat or comma-separate.
    --hide                Keep the task out of the picker and --list.
  --info <task>           Describe a task: what it runs, where it comes from, its plan.
  --check                 Validate all tasks without running anything.
  --json                  With --list, --info, or --check, write JSON.
  --guide                 Explain how to add tasks, for people and AI agents.
  --install-skill         Install the runx skill for Claude Code.
  --file <path>           Use an explicit runx.json path.
  --allow-parent-search   Allow config discovery beyond the safe search boundary.
  --dry-run               Print the resolved task without executing it.

Run 'runx --guide' to learn how to add tasks.
